about_the_game:
In a world that's seen destruction time and time again, a war of a race that's seen extinction before take place once again. You are part of the rebellion pushing your way through enemy lines hoping to one day reach and occupy the enemy capital. With limited time, supplies and alliances you set forth on you journey to Dormak.

Gather allies

Each city visited provides another opportunity to find new captains who are interested in joining your cause. Ask around, somebody might now their locations.

Plan Your Moves: Master the Art of Strategy

Success in this turbulent world demands more than just quick reflexes; it requires a strategist's mind. Our game empowers you to take control of the battlefield through careful planning and tactical acumen. Here's how you can leverage your planning skills:

Manage Your Supplies: Resourcefulness is Key

In a world on the brink of destruction, survival hinges not only on battle prowess but also on effective resource management. As a leader, you’ll need to carefully balance your needs to ensure your fleet remains operational and ready for anything.

Crucial Decisions: Shape Your Destiny

In this post-apocalyptic world, every decision you make can tip the scales between survival and destruction. You will face dilemmas that test your morals, strategies that challenge your leadership, and choices that determine the fate of machines and humankind alike.

Engage in Tactical Battles: Command Your Fleet

Prepare to test your strategic acumen in dynamic battles where every decision counts. Whether from a distance or up close, the combat offers a rich tapestry of tactical options, allowing you to engage enemies on your terms.

short_description: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.
